spans.s: पतग m. a winged animal, bird.
पतगपति m. the king of the birds, E. of Garuḍa.
पतग˚राज m. the king of the birds, E. of Garuḍa.
पतगेश्वर m. = prec., also E. of Jaṭāyu.
पतंगर॑ a. bird-like.
पतंगराज m. = पतगराज.

1 पतंगवृत्ति f. rashness, temerity, lit. the way of
a moth (attracted by a light).

2 पतंगवृत्ति a. very thoughtless or rash (cf.
prec.).
पतञ्जल m. N. of a man.
पतञ्जलि m. N. of a philosopher, grammarian, etc.
प॑तत्र n. wing, pinion, feather.
पतत्रिराज् m. = पतगराज.
प॑तत्रिराज m. = पतगराज.

पतद्ग्रह m. spitting-pot or alms-box (receiver of
what falls).

पतद्ग्राह m. spitting-pot or alms-box (receiver of
what falls).

पत्तन n. town, city;
 m. pl. N. of a people.
पातनीय a. to be caused to fall or thrown.
पतन्त् a. flying. m. a bird.

पतय् पत॑यति fly, hasten, M. drive away or fell.
—अच्छ & आ A. fly to (acc.). वि A. open, go or fly asunder.
पतयालु॑ a. flying.
पत˚यिष्णु॑ a. flying.
पत˚यिष्णुक॑ a. flying.
पतर॑ a. flying, fugitive.
पत॑रु a. flying, fugitive.

पताका f. flag, banner;
 the flag or symbol of (—˚).

पातक a. causing to fall (—˚);
 m. crime, sin.

पताकांशुक^1 n. flag or banner (-cloth).
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160418. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/289. note: anusvAra over 'u' wrong. cf ccs, mw, pw.
पताकादण्ड m. flag-staff.

पातकिन् a. criminal, wicked;
 m. sinner.
प॑ति m. master, owner, ruler, lord, husband.
पतिंवरा f. choosing her husband.
पतिक (adj. —˚) = पति.
पत्तिक a. walking on foot.
पतिघातिनी f. husband-slaying.
पति˚घ्नी f. husband-slaying.

प॑तिजुष्ट^1 a. loved by her husband.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160418. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/289. note: cf. ccs, pwg. cae also has juzwa.
पतितसावित्रीक a. having lost the Sāvitrī ((r.)).
पतितान्न n. food from an outcast.
पतितोत्थित a. fallen and risen (l.&f.).
पतित्व॑ n. matrimony, wedlock.
पति˚त्वन॑ n. matrimony, wedlock.

पतिदेवता f. a wife regarding her husband as a
divinity.
पति˚देवा f. a wife regarding her husband as a divinity.
पतिप्राणा f. a wife whose life is her husband.
पतिमती f. having a husband, married.
पतिलोक॑ m. the husband's world (in a future life).
प॑तिवती f. = पतिमती.
पतिवत्नी f. = पतिमती.
पतिव्रत n. devotion to a husband.
पतिव्रता f. a wife devoted or obedient to her husband.
प॑तिष्ठ (superl.) flying most or best.
पतिसेवा f. devotion to the husband.
पतीय् पती˚यति wish for a husband.
पतीयस् (compar.) w. पत् fly better or well.
पत्तत॑स् adv. = पत्त॑स्.
प॑त्तवे dat. inf. to 1 पद्.
पा॑तवे dat. inf. to 1 पा.
पत्त॑स् adv. from or at the feet.
पत्त्रक f. पत्त्रिका wing or leaf (adj. —˚).

पत्त्रच्छेदभक्ति f. interval between the
veins of a leaf.*
पत्त्रच्छेद्य n. a piece of leaf.
*पत्त्रपाश्या f. a kind of ornament on the forehead.

पत्त्रभङ्ग m. figures or lines painted on the face
or body.
पत्त्रय् पत्त्र˚यति pp. पत्त्रित (q.v.) to feather.
पत्त्ररथ m. a bird (having wings as a vehicle).
पत्त्रल a. leafy.
पत्त्रलेखा f. = पत्त्रभङ्ग.
पत्त्रविशेषक m. the same.
पत्त्रशाक n. vegetables consisting of leaves, greens.
*पत्त्राङ्ग n. red sandal.
*पत्त्राङ्गुलि f. = पत्त्रभङ्ग.
*पत्त्राङ्गु˚ली f. = पत्त्रभङ्ग.
पत्त्रारूढ a. written down (on a leaf).
पत्त्रावलि f. = पत्त्रभङ्ग.
पत्त्राव˚ली f. = पत्त्रभङ्ग.
पत्त्रित a. feathered (arrow).

पत्त्रिन् a. winged, feathered;
 m. bird, arrow.
पात्रिन् a. provided with a drinking vessel or a dish.

प॑त्नी f. mistress, lady, wife;
 abstr. ˚त्व† n.

पत्नीक^1 (adj. —˚) = prec.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160412. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/275.
पत्नीय् पत्नी˚यति regard or treat as a wife.
प॑त्नीवन्त् a. having a wife or wives.
प॑त्मन् n. flight, path, way.

प॑त्वन् f. पत्वरी flying;
 n. flight.
पत्सुतःशी॑ a. lying at the feet.
पत्सुत॑स् adv. at the feet.
पातयितृ m. who causes to fall or throws.
पा॑तवै॑ dat. inf. to 1 पा.
1 पातव्य a. to be drunk.
2 पातव्य a. to be protected.

पाताल n. lower world, abode of serpents or demons, also a
cert. hell.
पातुक a. falling, losing caste or going to hell.
1 पातृ॑ पा॑तृ m. drinker.
पा॑तृ m. drinker.
2 पातृ॑ m. protector, defender.
1 पात्य a. = पातनीय.
2 पात्य n. dominion, sway.

पात्रता f. ˚त्व n. capacity, fitness, worthiness (lit.
the being a receptacle).
